title: nyctocereus neumannii
intro: Nyctocereus neumannii, commonly known as Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nyctocereus neumannii include its potential in treating wounds, fever reduction, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
